title: Core A2.4: a soldier course of 19 is past what the mortar can carry
summary: Nineteen EC6-mortared soldiers span 1.235 m. The pier-face junctions read 1.08 in tension; the top two contacts at each face crack and the lower two keep their bond. The course still works mostly as a beam, its ends hogging with a thrust of only 149 N and shear carried on cohesion, so it stands cracked; arching takes over only near 41 soldiers. The plan expected it to slide out; the engine and the oracle's hinge sequence both stop after these four cracks.
